<?php
class ProducerBase215 { public static function capture($saved,$ignored) { echo "PRODUCER;",self::class,"/",static::class,";"; return $saved; } }
class ProducerScope215 extends ProducerBase215 { public static function launch() { global $owner,$argument; return $owner->MiSsInG((self::capture(...))($argument,shift215())); } } class ProducerChild215 extends ProducerScope215 {}
function shift215() { $GLOBALS["argument"] = new New215; $GLOBALS["owner"] = null; echo "SHIFT;"; return false; } class Old215 { public function __destruct() { echo "OLD;"; } } class New215 { public function __destruct() { echo "NEW;"; } }
class Base215 { public function __call(string $name,array $arguments) { $GLOBALS["argument"] = null; echo "HANDLER;"; return new class($arguments) { public function __construct(public array $saved) {} public function __destruct() { echo "CHILD;"; } }; } public function __destruct() { echo "OWNER;"; } } class Derived215 extends Base215 {}
$argument = new Old215; $owner = new Derived215; $child = ProducerChild215::launch(); echo "RETURN;"; echo ($child->saved[0] instanceof Old215) ? "HELD;" : "BAD;"; unset($child); echo "AFTER;";

<?php
class Ancestor215 { public static function seed() { echo "SEED;",self::class,"/",static::class,";"; return true; } } class Middle215 extends Ancestor215 { public static function launch() { global $owner; return $owner->MiSsInG((parent::seed(...))(),false); } } class Final215 extends Middle215 {}
class ParentMagic215 { public function __call(string $name,array $arguments) { echo ($arguments[0] === true && $arguments[1] === false) ? "HELD;" : "BAD;"; return 9; } }
$owner = new ParentMagic215; $value = Final215::launch(); echo $value === 9 ? "OK;" : "BAD;";

<?php
class Lexical215 { public static function seed() { echo "WRONG;"; return 2; } public static function launch() { global $owner; return $owner->MiSsInG(first:(static::seed(...))(),later:7); } } class Called215 extends Lexical215 { public static function seed() { echo "SELECTED;",self::class,"/",static::class,";"; return 1.5; } }
class NamedMagic215 { public function __call(string $name,array $arguments) { echo ($arguments["first"] === 1.5 && $arguments["later"] === 7) ? "HELD;" : "BAD;"; return false; } }
$owner = new NamedMagic215; $value = Called215::launch(); echo $value === false ? "OK;" : "BAD;";
